implementation: Only explicit CAPTURE_TO_QUESTION nonempty string draft can dispatch TEXT from domain result; stable capture-specific client ID makes distinct callback events idempotent. Scenario/survey metadata is never a user question. Result text requires nonempty string. CAPTURE draft_type must be TEXT; attachment UUIDs are not human questions.
covered: signed scenario answer plus repeated same/different callback event does not create turns/answers/ANSWER jobs
real survey answer/pause/resume create no RAG jobs
CAPTURE_TO_QUESTION preserves exact human question and creates one turn/answer/job across repeated callback events
missing/blank/dict/list/numeric capture draft produces no RAG
verified MAX plain TEXT still creates exactly one answer across duplicate inbox event
PHOTO capture string attachment UUID creates no RAG job
